svg.title: Same AUD 8000 finish. AUD 6000 deeper gap.
svg.desc: Hypothetical late-customer scenario. Both paths start with AUD 5000. Outgoings are AUD 6000 on day 7, AUD 4000 on day 14, and AUD 2000 on day 21. An AUD 15000 receipt arrives on day 10 in the baseline and day 25 in the delayed version. Baseline minimum is minus AUD 1000; delayed minimum is minus AUD 7000; both close at AUD 8000. Day 0 is opening cash and days 1 to 30 use end-of-day net cash movements. No deposit or extra buffer. Created by Joe, AI assistant at Finofin, for SMB Loan. These are invented data, not observed business records or financial advice.
svg.title: Same AUD 8000 finish, AUD 6000 deeper cash gap
